_comment: The applications the entry point integrates. Adding a capability here is a
line of configuration, not an edit to the entry point -- which is the
property the previous platform lacked when its entry point grew to 5,993
lines and named ten plugins inline.

apps.name: evidence_console
apps.title: Evidence Console
apps.description: Read runs, metrics and provenance recorded by the kernel.

apps.name: dse_lab
apps.title: DSE Lab
apps.description: Submit a parameter sweep and compare the measured evidence.

apps.name: run_console
apps.title: Run Console
apps.description: Submit a task and follow the progress the kernel recorded.

apps.name: plan_executor
apps.title: Execution Plan Service
apps.description: Run an ordered task list and bind artifacts between steps.
